_note: Project-level contextus config override — demonstrates all available options (tier 3, highest precedence). See docs/dev/DESIGN.md for the 3-tier merge: global plugin.json → ~/.contextus/config.json → ./.claude/contextus.json

providers._note: Shared connection settings — referenced by all features (embedding, expansion, calibration)

expansion._note: Multi-vector query expansion: generates alternate phrasings when initial search scores poorly. Dramatically improves synonym/paraphrase recall.
expansion._provider_values: ollama (local, fast) | bedrock (AWS, Haiku) | anthropic (direct API)
expansion._model_note: Model for the primary provider. Small/fast recommended for ollama.
expansion._fallback_note: Fallback fires only on fast failures (connection refused) with remaining time budget
expansion._expansionThreshold_note: Adaptive mode fires when best initial score < this (0.0-1.0)
expansion._maxVariants_note: Number of alternative phrasings to generate (2-5 recommended)
expansion._temperature_note: LLM temperature for variant generation (0.0-2.0, higher = more diverse)
expansion._timeoutMs_note: Total expansion time budget in ms. Shared between primary + fallback.
